differences.native: MySQL extracts four dot-delimited components with SUBSTRING_INDEX and detects leading zeros with REGEXP.
differences.app: SQLite recursively emits dot-delimited components, then aggregates their count, numeric bounds, and leading-zero flags.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks SUBSTRING_INDEX and the required REGEXP operator. Both classify the same invalid conditions, count duplicate invalid addresses, and use the same result ordering.
